title: A headless worker's worktree has the commit hooks, so its commits get their KB trailers
goal: A worktree the orchestrator makes with git worktree add for a headless worker runs the clone's commit hooks (core.hooksPath or kbgit.py install-hooks reaching linked worktrees), so a worker's commit gets its KB-* trailers without typing them; SP-2vhfsn4o: workers of ST-vku6q3n7, ST-yob4py65, ST-ly2p27q3, BG-xbxtbqwd and BG-rbokisbc found the hook missing and added KB-Work by hand
